name: Fluke Census
description: Identify individual flukes through a moving inspection lens; photograph every listed animal once as each shutter reshuffles the pod.
natural_language: Photograph every individual of the two listed species exactly once, then declare the census complete. Inspect tail edges through the lens. Every photograph rearranges the pod; photographed animals remain unmarked. A duplicate or off-list photograph ends the attempt.

metadata.notes: Original procedural fluke identity memory task; scripted evidence is not human or agent calibration.
